messages:
Jordan H: Quick sync — planning a blue-green deploy that includes a small schema change to user_profiles (add last_seen_source varchar(32)). Target window Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. Who's owning the deploy and the smoke run?
Mira K: I can own the deploy slot. I'll be on call for the window.
Sam T: I can do the smoke checks and run the post-migration queries. pls share the smoke checklist.
Jordan H: thanks. Smoke checklist (short): 1) run healthcheck endpoints behind proxy 2) run sample read/write to new column via API 3) run backfill sanity on a 1k sample 4) check QPS/latency dashboards.
Priya R: +1 on smoke list. Rollback plan: db user_profiles schema change is additive (new nullable col). If we need rollback we will: 1) stop traffic to green 2) switch router back to blue 3) run a quick migration to drop column (if needed) and revert any service flags. Full rollback playbook is in the runbook.
Sam T: paste of the migration command I'm planning to run in the canary (will run against canary DB first):
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD COLUMN last_seen_source VARCHAR(32);
-- verify
COMMIT;
```
Jordan H: we'll do canary on canary service + canary db (10% traffic) for 15m. If no regressions, ramp to 100% in 3 steps.
Mira K: timing note — we need a lightweight dual-write shim for 15min to capture any write regressions. Engineering agrees to keep dual-write for exactly 15m then flip.
Priya R: Confirmed backups & snapshots created @ 02:30 UTC, I've scheduled DB snapshot job.
deploy-bot: Deploy slot reserved: Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC, ticket RW-3124. Please tag with :rocket: when ready.
qa-bot: Quick smoke checklist link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/schema-bluegreen.md#smoke-checks
Sam T: I'll post smoke results in this thread. My quick checks: 1) API write to user_profiles with last_seen_source succeeds 2) sample search/rerank latency within 5% 3) no errors in service logs for 15m.
Jordan H: @Mira K @Sam T please confirm you're available at 02:45 UTC for preflight and 03:00 for handoff. Also add rollback contacts to oncall ping list.
Mira K: I'm available. adding Priya and Sam to oncall ping.
Sam T: available. I added queries I'll run to the runbook.
Priya R: I'll monitor DB metrics and be ready to trigger rollback if replication lag spikes or error rate rises >1%.
Jordan H: final ask — leave a short deploy note in RW-3124 with exact commands and smoke checklist. We'll aim for green in 15m then ramp.
Mira K: Roger. Will update ticket and ping here when canary is green. :white_check_mark:
Sam T: I'll start the preflight at 02:50 UTC and report back.
Priya R: Snapshot created at 02:30 UTC ✅
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 02:50 UTC preflight check — runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/schema-bluegreen.md
Jordan H: thanks team, posting runbook link again for visibility. Let's keep chatter here for the operation.
